title: In-situ and Ex-situ Conservation
notes: **In-situ and Ex-situ Conservation:** This topic covers the fundamental concepts of in-situ and ex-situ conservation in the biology curriculum.
Understanding in-situ and ex-situ conservation is essential for solving problems and building higher-level mathematical skills.
Key definitions and theorems related to in-situ and ex-situ conservation should be memorized and practiced regularly.
